messages.content: 你能幫我找到紐約有閱讀室和小說區的公共圖書館，然後在洛杉磯有Wi-Fi和有兒童區的公共圖書館，最後在芝加哥有咖啡廳和閱讀室的公共圖書館嗎？

function.description: Locate nearby public libraries based on specific criteria like English fiction availability and Wi-Fi. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

2) In Los Angeles, have Wi-Fi AND Children Section.

3) In Chicago, have Cafe AND Reading Room.

The function expects one set of facilities; but each query may include multiple items. For example, first request: location="New York", facilities=["Reading Room","Fiction"]. Second: location="Los Angeles", facilities=["Wi-Fi","Children Section"]. Third: location="Chicago", facilities=["Cafe","Reading Room"].

But note that facility options are limited to enumerated values: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe". So yes.
